fixes: Preserve buffer-transported subnormal inputs and the minimum-double constant despite Studio flushing native literals.

fixture_transport: Subnormal numeric fixture values are constructed from raw IEEE-754 bytes with buffer.readf64, preserving the JavaScript oracle input bits through Studio parsing.
native_runtime_limitation: Roblox can flush subnormal numeric literals and operations to zero. Use decimal strings for such inputs; a value already converted to zero by Roblox cannot be recovered by the library.
